evidence: Ccecil runs used commercial assembly equipment and says an OpenPnP-based machine would likely be their choice without it; this is not a claim of first-hand OpenPnP use.

evidence_sources.author: Ccecil
evidence_sources.excerpt: I run some used Manncorp/Autotronik equipment. Pnp, oven, bunch of hand tools and such for rework (Metcal irons). If I didn't have this I would likely build a line using an openpnp based machine.

source_story_title: The Grid, a factory-scale robot in Massachusetts that builds PCBs on demand
